description: STRAUB-GRIP-L two-lock-bolt axial-restraint pipe coupling with a hollow rolled casing, EPDM sealing sleeve, two anchoring rings, two hollow D-section closure bars, two tangent return strips, and two transverse socket-head lock bolts.

modeling_notes: The four catalog rows use the fixed two-lock-bolt construction. One-lock-bolt sizes and the contradictory STR21150 row are excluded.

fitted_pipe_od is an installation state constrained by the selected Dixon row's published min/max pipe O.D. range; it adjusts only the modeled sleeve and grip-ring bore. Connected pipe geometry is not included.
The product model contains no connected pipe. The centre is a genuine continuous bore through the coupling components.

The casing is one continuous circumferential outer sheet: its two full-width tangent runs continue into rolled edges around the hollow D-section bars. The D bars, anchoring rings, EPDM sleeve, and two transverse lock bolts are separate modeled bodies based on the published STRAUB side/end views and supplied reference images.

Published B, C, DV, R, pipe O.D. and range values are used exactly for each Dixon catalog row. Individual sheet thicknesses, seal-lip profile, stamped-tooth pitch, D-bar cross-section, bolt-head detail, local pressed bolt-clearance windows, and thread forms are honest proportions because they are not dimensioned in the sources.
Optional strip insert is not modeled because it is not part of the standard EPDM configuration.
